comment: ANCHOR: OVERVIEW_PROJECTION_20261109 — /api/v2/overview serves the OverviewProjection@v1 that lane
overview-projection builds out of process, only while it is at most 150 s old, from the serving release,
and began after the last operator write that can change the overview; otherwise the route computes
inline exactly as before and names the reason in _projection (LQ-20261107-1612). Never blank. A failed
build keeps the previous file; an overlapping build is refused. Synthetic documents only.
